info.title: Appear API
info.description:
Appear gives teams a live API catalog for humans and AI agents—indexing services, versions, and security posture in one durable source of truth.

Use this API to publish and retrieve catalog metadata, fetch machine-readable OpenAPI docs, manage project-scoped versions, and sync traffic analyzer insights so clients can discover the right endpoints with the correct authentication.

projectApiKey.description: Project API key authentication. Use your project API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

personalAccessToken.description: Personal access token authentication. Use your personal access token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Suitable for MCP integrations, CLI tools, and other OAuth flows.

ProseMirrorContentSchema.description: A recursive schema modeling ProseMirror document/node structure. It mirrors the ProseMirror JSON format as described at https://prosemirror.net/docs/guide/#schema.serialization. Each node may contain a `type`, optional `attrs`, children in `content`, formatting `marks`, and inline `text`.
